analysis.purpose: NestJS and TypeORM framework-semantics extraction: on top of the syntactic symbol graph, derives the stereotypes, routes and wiring that let a team understand a NestJS service without reading it.
responsibilities: Tag each class with its NestJS stereotype and framework
Derive the route table from the annotations or decorators that declare it
Resolve the dependency wiring between components
Attach the result to the existing symbol nodes rather than inventing new ones

businessRules.rule: Framework meaning is derived from the syntactic graph that already exists, not from a second parse.
businessRules.rationale: One parse, one source of truth — a second pass could disagree with the first.

businessRules.rule: Only what the annotations actually declare is surfaced; nothing is inferred from naming convention.
businessRules.rationale: An inferred route would be indistinguishable from a declared one downstream.

nodes.summary: Stereotypes, routes and wiring for NestJS services.
